Orientation types

Used by "Show libraries and videos" (Settings, or 👁 in the header). Group < library < video tag: a library's own type beats its group's, and a video's orientation tag beats both. A library follows the group it is directly in; a subgroup without a type follows its parent. Nothing set = Mixed (always shown).

Which player

Make them for

VLC Local Path Mapping

Map each container volume to the corresponding local network path or drive letter. Leave a field blank if you don't need VLC for that volume.

Server pathLocal path on this computer

Server path = how the video's path starts in lustr (e.g. /media0). The longest matching server path wins. Local path = UNC path (\\server\share) or drive letter (C:\path). These are saved in this browser only. A new server path also needs a volume in compose.yml before lustr can see its videos.

Windows Users: Install VLC Protocol Handler

For VLC links to work properly on Windows, you need to install the protocol handler:

Download install_vlc_link.bat

Run the downloaded .bat file as Administrator

UNC: \\192.168.1.100\Videos

UNC: \\server\media

Drive: C:\Users\YourName\Videos

Drive: Z:\Movies

How tags from StashDB / ThePornDB scenes become your own values when you use Suggest metadata (right-click a video → 🌐 Find scene). Auto = the tag's name matched one of your values; Confirmed = set by you; Ignored = never suggested. Click a status to change it. Pre-tick says when Suggest metadata ticks it for you (Default follows Overview → Pre-tick). One tag can map to several values of a field - separate them with commas (Thigh-high boots → outfit: thigh.highs, boots).

Unmapped tags

What's pre-ticked follows the Pre-tick choices above, and each tag's own rule. Nothing is added until you click Add, and nothing you already have is removed.

Match scenes

Searches for each video's scene the same way Find scene does. A video is linked automatically only when the best match scores 85+, is at least 20 points ahead of the next, and two or more independent signals agree (same length, a linked performer, the site's studio, the same date, or the title). Everything else goes to a review list. ThePornDB movies are always reviewed. Your metadata isn't changed unless you tick the option below.

Bulk link performers

Checks performers who aren't linked yet and links only 100% matches: an exact match on a full (multi-word) name, no gender conflict, and no other strong candidate. Attributes are never changed. If a performer has no photo, the external photo is added.
